app.disclaimer: VIGIX FIXED SUPPRESSION is a design-support tool. It does not replace the judgment or signature of a competent professional, does not certify compliance with any standard and does not guarantee approval by the authority having jurisdiction. Results depend on the input data, manufacturer data and the loaded normative profile; an unverified profile produces informational results only. Every design must be reviewed, signed and approved by the competent parties before construction.
app.name: VIGIX FIXED SUPPRESSION
app.scope_limits: Out of scope: CFD, actuation of real equipment, market prices not supplied by the user, reproduction of protected normative text and any guarantee of authority approval.

issue.ce.release_delay_too_short: The delay of release “{object}” ({delay_s} s) is shorter than the minimum ({min_s} s).

Add the pre-discharge alarm to the same rule.

issue.ce.release_without_trigger.action: Create the rule that triggers it.
issue.ce.rule_incomplete: Rule “{object}” needs at least one input and one output.

issue.data.bad_enum.action: Choose one of the allowed values.
issue.data.missing.action: Provide the value. It is never replaced by zero or an assumed value.
issue.data.not_positive.action: Fix the value; zero is not valid in this field.
issue.data.out_of_range.action: Enter a value within the range.
issue.data.type.action: Fix the value (number, text or list depending on the field).
issue.drychem.discharge_time_exceeds: The discharge time ({time_s} s) exceeds the profile maximum ({limit_s} s).
issue.drychem.discharge_time_short: The discharge time ({time_s} s) is shorter than the profile minimum ({min_s} s).
issue.drychem.nozzle_capacity_insufficie: The nozzles need {time_needed_s} s to discharge the mass and the discharge time is {discharge_time_s} s.
Add nozzles or use a higher flow.
issue.drychem.occupied_total_flooding: Total flooding with powder in an occupied space: visibility and respiratory risk.
issue.ext.grid_too_large: The analysis grid of level “{object}” is too large ({cells} cells; max {max}).
issue.ext.insufficient_by_area: Zone “{object}” needs {required} (class {fire_class}) and has {have} inside it.
issue.ext.mount_height_exceeds: The mounting height of “{object}” ({height_m} m) exceeds the profile limit ({limit_m} m).
issue.ext.no_serving_unit: Zone “{object}” has no extinguisher suitable for class {fire_class} (hazard {hazard_class}).
issue.ext.no_serving_unit.action: Add a compatible unit with the minimum rating.
issue.ext.no_zones: There are no zones (rooms) to analyze.
issue.ext.no_zones.action: Draw zones with hazard class and fire classes.
issue.ext.uncovered_area: In “{object}”, {uncovered_m2} m² are outside the travel distance ({max_travel_m} m) for class {fire_class}.
issue.ext.uncovered_area.action: Add or relocate extinguishers. Use “Suggest locations”.
issue.ext.unit_in_obstacle: Unit “{object}” sits on a wall or obstacle (snapped to the nearest free cell).
issue.ext.unit_in_obstacle.action: Move it to an accessible position.
issue.ext.unit_level_unknown: Unit “{object}” is on a non-existent level ({level}).
issue.ext.unit_outside_zones: Unit “{object}” is not inside any zone.
issue.ext.unit_outside_zones.action: Place it inside a zone or define the zone.
issue.ext.unit_unreachable: Unit “{object}” cannot be placed on a walkable cell.
issue.ext.unsuitable_agent_present: Unit “{object}” ({agent}) is not suitable for class {fire_class} present in zone “{zone}”.
issue.ext.unsuitable_agent_present.actio: Replace it with a suitable agent.
issue.ext.zone_without_free_cells.action: Check walls and the zone outline.
issue.foam.proportioner_out_of_range: The solution flow ({flow_lpm} L/min) is outside the proportioner range [{min_lpm}, {max_lpm}] L/min.
issue.foam.tank_insufficient: The concentrate tank ({capacity_l} L) is not enough: it needs {required_l} L.
issue.gas.below_min_concentration: The design concentration ({design_pct} %) is below the profile minimum ({min_pct} %).
issue.gas.cylinder_underfilled: Each cylinder would hold {fill_kg} kg, below the minimum fill ({min_kg} kg).
issue.gas.cylinder_underfilled.action: Reduce the number of cylinders or use another size.
issue.gas.discharge_time_exceeds: The discharge time ({time_s} s) exceeds the profile maximum ({limit_s} s).
issue.gas.discharge_time_exceeds.action: Reduce the time (more nozzles or flow).
issue.gas.enclosure_integrity_not_evalua: Enclosure integrity (door-fan test) is NOT evaluated by the software.
Perform the test on site and record the result.
issue.gas.hold_time_short: The hold time ({hold_min} min) is shorter than required ({required_min} min).
issue.gas.hold_time_untested: There is no hold-time test; the profile requires {required_min} min.
issue.gas.hold_time_untested.action: Perform the enclosure integrity test and record the result.
issue.gas.occupied_exceeds_loael: In an occupied space, the concentration ({design_pct} %) exceeds the LOAEL ({loael_pct} %).
issue.gas.occupied_exceeds_loael.action: Not acceptable with people present: reduce the concentration or declare the space unoccupied with verifiable measures.
issue.gas.occupied_exceeds_noael: In an occupied space, the concentration ({design_pct} %) exceeds the NOAEL ({noael_pct} %).
issue.gas.occupied_exceeds_noael.action: Requires review by the human-safety specialist.
issue.gas.specific_volume_invalid: The computed specific volume is not valid ({s} m³/kg).
issue.gas.specific_volume_invalid.action: Check the minimum temperature and the agent constants.
issue.gas.unoccupied_declared: The space is declared unoccupied: limits for people are not applied.
issue.gas.unoccupied_declared.action: This declaration is the designer's responsibility; verify it with access-control measures.
issue.gas.venting_not_evaluated: Pressure-relief venting is NOT evaluated by the software.
issue.gas.venting_not_evaluated.action: It must be evaluated by the specialist before construction.
issue.gate.exception_applied: An approved exception was applied to {code} in “{result}”.
issue.gate.no_design_date: The project design date is missing.
issue.gate.no_design_date.action: Enter it to check profile validity.
issue.gate.profile_demo: Profile {code} is a demonstration profile (fictitious values).

issue.gate.profile_hash_changed: The installed profile fingerprint differs from the one used in the project.
issue.gate.profile_hash_changed.action: The profile changed. Recalculate and request review again.
issue.gate.profile_missing: Profile {code} v{version} is not installed on this computer.
issue.gate.profile_missing.action: Import it (Profiles > Import) or choose another.
issue.gate.profile_not_covering: The profile does not cover system type “{system}”.
issue.gate.profile_not_covering.action: Use a profile whose scope includes this system.
issue.gate.profile_not_verified: Profile {code} v{version} is not verified by a specialist.
issue.gate.profile_not_verified.action: Results are “informational only”. Request profile verification.
issue.gate.result_stale: Calculation “{result}” is stale: data, profile or engine changed.
issue.gate.review_stale: The reviewer's approval predates the current data.
issue.gate.unresolved_error.action: Fix the design or request an exception approved by the reviewer.
issue.geo.coordinate_out_of_range.action: Check the drawing scale or units.
issue.geo.door_invalid: Door “{object}” is not valid (it needs two distinct points).
issue.geo.door_suspicious_width: Door “{object}” has a suspiciously large width.
issue.geo.duplicate_id.action: Every object must have a unique identifier.
issue.geo.polygon_self_intersects.action: Fix the outline so it does not self-intersect.
issue.geo.polygon_too_few_points.action: Draw a polygon with at least 3 points (walls: 2).
issue.geo.rooms_overlap.action: Adjust the outlines: zones must not share area.
issue.geo.wall_thickness_suspicious: Wall “{object}” has a suspicious thickness ({thickness_m} m).
issue.hyd.active_not_device: Node “{node}” is not a device and cannot be activated.
issue.hyd.active_not_device.action: Activate only sprinklers, nozzles, hydrants or hose valves.
issue.hyd.active_unknown: The scenario activates a non-existent node: “{node}”.
issue.hyd.active_unknown.action: Fix the list of active devices.
issue.hyd.design_area_small: The area covered by active sprinklers ({covered_m2} m²) is smaller than the design area ({required_m2} m²).
issue.hyd.design_area_small.action: Activate more sprinklers in the remote area.
issue.hyd.device_ambiguous: Device “{object}” defines both a K-factor and a fixed flow.
issue.hyd.duplicate_id.action: Every node and link needs a unique identifier.
issue.hyd.link_self_loop: Link “{object}” starts and ends at the same node.
issue.hyd.min_flow: “{object}” discharges {flow_lpm} L/min, below the required minimum ({required_lpm} L/min).
issue.hyd.min_flow.action: Increase available pressure or pipe sizes.
issue.hyd.min_pressure: “{object}” has {pressure_bar} bar, below the required minimum ({required_bar} bar).
issue.hyd.min_pressure.action: Increase available pressure or pipe sizes.
issue.hyd.negative_pressure: Negative pressure at “{object}” ({pressure_bar} bar): the available head is not enough.
issue.hyd.negative_pressure.action: Increase source pressure, reduce losses or lower the elevation.
issue.hyd.no_design_criteria: There is no design criterion to size the required pressure.
issue.hyd.no_design_criteria.action: Define the hazard class, minimum flow or minimum pressure at devices.
issue.hyd.no_source: The network has no water source (supply, tank or pump with tank).
issue.hyd.node_isolated: Node “{node}” is isolated from the source (no load).
issue.hyd.node_unreachable: Node “{node}” has an active load but is not connected to any source.
issue.hyd.not_converged: The hydraulic calculation did not converge ({iterations} iterations).
issue.hyd.not_converged.action: Do not use these results. Check the model (pumps, valves, extreme values).
issue.hyd.numerical_failure: Numerical failure during the hydraulic calculation ({detail}).
issue.hyd.pump_curve_invalid: The curve of pump “{object}” is not valid (flow increasing, pressure decreasing).
issue.hyd.pump_curve_invalid.action: Fix it or provide the manufacturer's certified curve.
issue.hyd.pump_out_of_curve: Pump “{object}” operates outside its curve ({flow_lpm} L/min; max {max_lpm} L/min).
issue.hyd.pump_out_of_curve.action: Select another pump or review the demand.
issue.hyd.required_pressure_not_found: No source pressure satisfying the criteria was found up to {limit_bar} bar.
issue.hyd.required_pressure_not_found.ac: Increase pipe sizes or review the criteria.
issue.hyd.required_source_missing: No source was selected for sizing.
issue.hyd.required_source_missing.action: Select the source in the scenario (required_source).
issue.hyd.residual_too_large.action: Do not use these results; check the model.
issue.hyd.resistance_invalid: The resistance of link “{object}” could not be computed.
issue.hyd.scenario_not_found.action: Create the scenario or choose an existing one.
issue.hyd.singular: The hydraulic system is singular (part of the network has no source).
issue.hyd.supply_curve_invalid: Invalid supply curve: static pressure ({static} bar) must exceed residual ({residual} bar).
issue.hyd.supply_insufficient: The supply is insufficient: it needs {required_bar} bar at {flow_lpm} L/min but only has {available_bar} bar.
issue.hyd.supply_insufficient.action: Add a pump or tank, or reduce the demand.
issue.hyd.tank_volume_insufficient: Tank “{object}” is not enough: it needs {required_m3} m³ and has {usable_m3} m³ usable.
issue.hyd.tank_volume_unchecked: The volume of tank “{object}” could not be checked (duration or usable volume missing).
issue.hyd.tank_volume_unchecked.action: Enter the hazard class and the usable volume.
issue.hyd.velocity_exceeds: Velocity {velocity_m_s} m/s in “{object}” exceeds the profile limit ({limit_m_s} m/s).
issue.kitchen.fuel_shutoff_missing: The profile requires fuel/power shutoff and it is not provided.
issue.kitchen.no_appliances: The kitchen system has no appliances.
issue.kitchen.nozzles_insufficient: Appliance “{object}” ({type}) lacks nozzles: it needs {required} and has {provided}.
issue.kitchen.nozzles_insufficient.actio: Add nozzles according to the manufacturer's listing.
issue.kitchen.tank_capacity_exceeded: Flow numbers ({flow_numbers}) exceed the tank capacity ({capacity}).
issue.kitchen.tank_capacity_exceeded.act: Use a larger tank or fewer nozzles.
issue.kitchen.zone_nozzles_insufficient: Not enough nozzles in {zone}: needs {required}, has {provided}.
Add nozzles according to the listing.
issue.license.bad_signature: The license signature is not valid.
issue.license.bad_signature.action: Freemium remains. Request a genuine license.
issue.license.machine_mismatch: The license is bound to another computer.
issue.license.machine_mismatch.action: Request a license for this computer using its request code.
issue.license.malformed: The license file is not valid.
issue.license.not_pro: The license is not a PRO edition.
issue.license.wrong_product: The license is not for this product.
issue.license.wrong_product.action: Request the VIGIX FIXED SUPPRESSION license.
issue.profile.approval_ref_missing: The profile is marked approved but gives no approval reference.
issue.profile.approval_ref_missing.actio: Give the specialist's approval record or document.
issue.profile.authorship_incomplete.acti: Complete author, specialist reviewer and date.
issue.profile.bad_approval_status: The profile approval status is not valid.
issue.profile.bad_approval_status.action: Use borrador, revisado, aprobado or retirado.
issue.profile.bad_family: The profile's normative family is not valid.
issue.profile.bad_family.action: Use NFPA, EN-ISO, NACIONAL-LOCAL or OTRA.
issue.profile.bad_schema: The package does not have the expected profile schema.
issue.profile.bad_schema.action: Use a package built according to the profile guide.
issue.profile.bad_unit_system: The profile unit system is not valid.
issue.profile.demo.action: Use it only to try the software. Load a specialist-approved profile for a real project.
issue.profile.empty_scope: The profile does not declare the systems it covers.
issue.profile.empty_scope.action: List the covered system types in its scope.
issue.profile.expired: The profile had expired on the project's design date.
issue.profile.hash_mismatch: The profile fingerprint does not match: the content changed after sealing.
issue.profile.hash_mismatch.action: Do not trust this package. Obtain it again from the specialist or re-seal it after a new review.
issue.profile.hash_missing: The profile does not include its SHA-256 fingerprint.
issue.profile.hash_missing.action: Seal the package with the profile tool to compute the fingerprint.
issue.profile.internal: Internal error while registering the profile.
issue.profile.internal.action: Retry; if it persists, check the audit log.
issue.profile.method_empty: The profile declares an empty method.
issue.profile.method_missing: The profile declares no method for “{module}”.
issue.profile.method_missing.action: Add the method to the profile.
issue.profile.method_unsupported: Method “{method}” ({module}) is not supported by this engine.
issue.profile.method_unsupported.action: Use a method supported by this version or update the program.
issue.profile.missing_section.action: Complete the package following the profile template.
issue.profile.no_sources: The profile declares no sources (code, edition, effective date).
issue.profile.no_sources.action: Declare each normative document with its exact edition.
issue.profile.no_test_cases: The profile includes no test cases for “{system}”.
issue.profile.no_test_cases.action: The specialist must provide independent test cases with expected results.
issue.profile.not_approved: The profile is not approved by a specialist (status: {status}).
issue.profile.not_approved.action: Result is “unverified / informational only”. Request approval from the designated specialist.
issue.profile.not_yet_effective: The profile was not yet in force on the project's design date.
issue.profile.not_yet_effective.action: Choose a profile in force on that date or correct the design date.
issue.profile.out_of_table_range: Value {x} is outside the range of table “{table}”; it is not extrapolated.
issue.profile.out_of_table_range.action: Check the data (altitude, temperature, diameter...) or extend the profile with specialist approval.
issue.profile.param_invalid: Profile parameter with an invalid value (“{param}”).
issue.profile.param_invalid.action: Fix the value in the profile.
issue.profile.param_missing.action: The calculation is blocked: the program does not invent normative values. Complete the profile.
issue.profile.ref_missing: A profile parameter or row has no reference to its source.
issue.profile.ref_missing.action: Every value must cite the chapter, section or table of the authorized source.
issue.profile.source_incomplete: A profile source is incomplete (“{field}” missing).
issue.profile.source_incomplete.action: Complete body, code, title, edition and effective date.
issue.profile.table_ambiguous: Table “{table}” has several rows for the same combination.
issue.profile.table_ambiguous.action: Fix the profile: each combination must be unique.
issue.profile.table_no_row: Profile table “{table}” has no row for that key combination.
issue.profile.table_no_row.action: The calculation is blocked (value outside the table). Check the data or complete the profile.
issue.profile.unit_invalid: The profile uses an unknown unit: “{unit}”.
issue.profile.unit_invalid.action: Use units from the program's unit table.
issue.profile.unit_mismatch: Incompatible unit in the profile: “{have}” cannot be converted to “{want}”.
issue.profile.unit_mismatch.action: Fix the parameter unit in the profile.
issue.profile.unknown_system: The profile declares an unknown system: “{system}”.
issue.profile.unknown_system.action: Use the system identifiers defined by the engine.
issue.profile.version_conflict: Profile {code} version {version} already exists with different content.
issue.profile.version_conflict.action: A published profile is immutable: publish a new version.
issue.profile.withdrawn.action: Do not use it for new projects; choose a current version.
issue.project.assumption_unconfirmed.act: Confirm or correct it. Unconfirmed assumptions block the conformity report.
issue.project.bad_design_date: The design date “{value}” is not valid (format YYYY-MM-DD).
issue.project.bad_language: The project language is not valid.
issue.project.bad_unit_system: The project unit system is not valid.
issue.project.missing_section.action: The file is incomplete or damaged; restore a backup.
issue.project.newer_schema: The project uses a newer schema (“{schema}”) and will not be opened to avoid data loss.
issue.project.newer_schema.action: Update VIGIX FIXED SUPPRESSION to a version that supports it.
issue.project.no_design_date: No design date has been entered.
issue.project.no_design_date.action: Enter it under Project > Data: it is used to check profile validity (the computer clock is not used).
issue.project.no_profile.action: Select a profile under Project > Jurisdiction. Calculations are not possible without one.
issue.project.unsupported_schema.action: Open the file with the VIGIX version that created it, or migrate the project.
issue.safety.co2_high_risk: CO₂ in an occupied space: high risk of death by asphyxiation.
issue.safety.co2_high_risk.action: Requires additional specialist review and reinforced safeguards.
issue.safety.co2_lockout_missing: The CO₂ lock-out valve is missing.
issue.safety.delay_too_short: The pre-discharge delay ({delay_s} s) is shorter than the minimum ({min_s} s).
issue.safety.evacuation_not_verified: Evacuation is not verified in an occupied space.
issue.safety.predischarge_alarm_missing: The pre-discharge alarm is missing in an occupied space.
It is mandatory: confirm it exists.
issue.store.invalid.action: Use letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore (max 64).
issue.store.not_found: The requested item was not found.

status.permit_package: SUBMISSION PACKAGE — subject to external signature and approval; does not certify conformity
